Pi --tools validation fix in args.js works (lines 70-82: both branches push to validTools, extension tools get info diagnostic). But it exposed a downstream type mismatch in sdk.js:129 — CLI passes string[] but createAgentSession expects {name}[] and calls .name on each. Fix: use `typeof t === 'string' ? t : t.name` at sdk.js:129.

The pi --tools extension fix required THREE files, not two: args.js (accept unknown tools), sdk.js (handle string vs object), AND main.js (allTools[name] ?? name to avoid undefined). The main.js mapping at lines 289/296 was the actual crash source — allTools["web_search"] returns undefined, creating [undefined, undefined] which then crashed sdk.js. Always trace the full data flow from CLI parse → main.js mapping → sdk.js consumption.

Verified dispatch-parallel multi-instance support across 3 extension files. Key architecture: ParallelInstanceMeta carries instanceKey (e.g. "scout::pCALLID::1"), sessionSuffix ("-pSHORT-1"), and displayName ("Scout #1"). activeRuns Map is separate from agentStates to avoid roster pollution. finalizeRun is the single cleanup point called from both close and error handlers. team-comms and domain-lock both normalize via split(/[#:]/)[0]. No integration tests possible — verification is code-inspection only.
